transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, I just feel worn out all the time. Even after a full night in bed, it's like... my body is made of sandbags. Just getting through a workday, or even folding laundry... it takes everything I have. So, I guess that's why I came in.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, and if so, how long has this been going on?

Yeah... I guess you could say that. Most days I just wake up with this... heavy, flat feeling in my chest. I'm not really sure how long it's been. But I'll just sit at the kitchen table, staring out at the yard, and... I don't know. It just feels like there isn't really a good version of the future coming.
How long have you been feeling this way most days — like there’s a heavy, flat feeling in your chest and things feel hopeless?
Um... probably... about two months? Just... that slowed-down, exhausted feeling. It's been most days since then, I guess.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends, don't bring you the same pleasure lately?

I suppose so. I used to... I'd make time for hiking, or yoga. I had a garden, and I liked taking pictures of birds. But lately... I don't know. I just keep canceling things. My camera is just sitting in the closet. It just... doesn't feel worth the effort to get it out.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or maybe feeling restless and unable to sit still, and if so, how long has this been happening?

I don't really know... I guess my husband said something the other day. He told me I've been moving around the house like I'm underwater. And... sometimes he asks me a simple question, and... it just takes me a while to answer. The words just come out really slowly. I'm not sure how long it's been like that.
How long have you been feeling like you're moving underwater or taking longer to answer simple questions?
I'm not exactly sure... but probably the same amount of time. The whole... feeling exhausted and slowed down thing has been happening most days for about two months now.
Has your mood been consistently low or have you felt a lack of interest in almost everything for most of the day, nearly every day, over the past two months?

Yeah... pretty much. Most days I just... I wake up with this heavy, flat feeling in my chest. I don't really know how else to describe it. I'll just sit at the kitchen table for a long time, staring out at the yard... just feeling like there isn't any good version of the future coming. So... yes.
Have you had periods of low mood or loss of interest in things for most days over the past two years?
No... I don't think so. Not for two years. Just... what I mentioned before.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
No, I don't think so. My appetite is... about the same as usual, I guess. I haven't really noticed any weight changes either.
Have you felt so slowed down that even simple tasks felt almost impossible, or at times felt so restless that you couldn't stay in one place?

I guess... my husband says I move around the house like I'm underwater lately. And sometimes... if he asks me a simple question, it just takes me a long time to answer. The words just... come out really slowly. So, yeah, maybe slowed down.
Have you been having any trouble with your sleep lately, like waking up very early or not being able to fall asleep?
Not really. I... I think I sleep fine. Just the usual amount, I guess. I haven't noticed any trouble with it.
Have you ever felt this way before — like you're completely worn out and hopeless — or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?
I don't know... maybe? I mean, I've had times where I felt down before, but... I don't really remember if it was exactly like this. I haven't really kept track.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic, upbeat, or irritable — like you didn’t need much sleep or had a lot more ideas than usual?

I mean... there was a time recently. Right after we signed the mortgage papers. I just... I don't know, I felt kind of lit up, I guess. Like I couldn't be stopped. But then... I'd just get so annoyed. Like, snapping at my husband or people at work if things were taking too long. It was just... a lot of back and forth.
How long did that period of feeling unusually energetic and irritable last — was it just a day or two, or did it go on for a week or more?
I'm not really sure. I didn't write it down or anything. Maybe a few days? I just... I don't remember exactly how long it went on.
Can you remember if that time when you felt unusually energetic and irritable lasted for at least four days in a row, or did it come and go more quickly than that?
I really don't know. Like I said, I wasn't keeping track of the days. It might have been four... or maybe less. I just can't give you an exact number.
Can you try to remember if that time when you felt unusually energetic and irritable stayed for at least four days straight, or did it only come and go in a shorter amount of time?
I... I don't know what else to tell you. I just... I didn't count the days. It's a blur. I can't say for sure.
Was there ever a time when you felt so energetic or irritable that it was noticeably different from your usual self, and did that feeling last for at least four full days in a row without fading?
I mean... yes, I've felt noticeably different before. Really wired, or just on edge. But like I keep telling you, I don't know about the four days. I just... I don't have a better answer for you.
Can you think back and try to recall if there was ever a time when you felt unusually energetic or irritable that lasted for at least four full days in a row without fading?
I... I really don't have a different answer for you. Asking me again isn't going to make me remember. I just don't know how many days it was.
Have there been times recently when something good happened, like a compliment or a nice moment with a friend, and you actually felt a bit better, even if just for a little while?
I don't really know. I guess... maybe? Sometimes things happen, but... I don't really pay attention to whether it makes me feel better. It just is what it is.
Can you think back and try to recall if there was ever a time when you felt unusually energetic or irritable that lasted for at least four full days in a row without fading?
I... I really don't know what else to say. We just talked about this. I don't keep track of the days like that. It's just... I can't give you a different answer.
